locator: II-II q.154 a.7 co. and ad 4
interpretation: The body classifies rape as a species of lust and distinguishes forcible unlawful violation of a virgin from removal against her father’s wishes with her consent. Reply 4 treats violence by a newly married husband as sinful but not rape in this historical category. This reading neither equates his classification with modern consent-based definitions nor derives a categorical reason independent of an offender’s ends.
